title: Inertia of a body with its own mark against its cost

key_results.statement: For one Model D body on the ring field with coupling (a), (c) or the full grip, the sector contract has the form (6.1) with $\hat C^{(0)}_\sigma=\theta\sigma M_k+C_1+g_\sigma\Phi_0$ and $\hat C^{(+)}=\frac\tau2(-i\sigma_1)\otimes K$; for the full grip (6.1) applies unchanged, only $\hat C^{(0)}$ changes ($\theta=0$).

Wherever the $\tau=0$ level is isolated at distance $d_{k,\sigma}$: $E''_{k,\sigma}(0)=2\tau^2J_{k,\sigma}+O(\tau^4\lVert K\rVert^4/d_{k,\sigma}^3)$ with $J_{k,\sigma}=\langle\Omega_\sigma\vert K(E^0_\sigma-\hat C^{(0)}_{-\sigma})^{-1}K\vert\Omega_\sigma\rangle$, exact in $\gamma$.

$\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}=\sigma R_k+C^{\rm ev}_k$ and, at order $\tau^{-2}$, $\mu_{k,\sigma}=\sigma R_k/[\tau^2(a^2_{k,\sigma}+2\sigma R_kJ^{\rm exc}_{k,\sigma})]$: the inertia is set by the branch-odd part of the held cost; the dressed level at $P=0$ differs from the held level by $O(\tau^2)$ without the factor $1/R_k$.

Full-grip isolation (sufficient): $\tau<d_{k,\sigma}/2$ with $d\simeq\min(2n|\gamma|M_k,\varepsilon_1)$ (lower branch, isolated for every $\gamma\neq0$, $L$, $N_f$) and $d\simeq\min(2n|\gamma|M_k,\varepsilon_1-2n|\gamma|M_k)$ (upper branch); for $N_f=1$ the upper branch is isolated for every $\gamma\neq0$, for $N_f\ge2$ it lies below all excited lower-branch levels iff $\Delta_b<\varepsilon_1^-$; $d_{k,\sigma}\to0$ as $\gamma\to0$ and, for the upper branch, as $L\to\infty$ at fixed $n,\gamma$, so the criterion fails there at every fixed $\tau>0$.

Weak-mark expansions: $R_k=\theta M_k+n\gamma M_k[1+\gamma^2M_k^2(s_1^2-s_2/L)]+O(\gamma^5)$, $C^{\rm ev}_k=-n\gamma^2M_k^2\ell_0/t_f+O(\gamma^4)$, $a^2=(1+\theta_c\gamma n)^2-2ng^2S_2+O(\gamma^3)$, $J^{\rm exc}=2n\langle\cos q(1+\cos q)u_q^2/(2\sigma R_k-\varepsilon_q)\rangle_q+O(\gamma^3)$, under R1 (full grip) or (6.4) at $\tau=0$ ((a), (c)).

Full grip, under (5.4) and R1 ($N_f\varkappa_k\ll1$): $E''_{k,\sigma}(0)=\frac{\tau^2}{n\sigma\gamma M_k}[1-\gamma^2M_k^2K_L+O(N_f^2\varkappa_k^3)]+O(\tau^4/d_{k,\sigma}^3)$, $K_L=2nS_2+s_1^2-s_2/L\simeq(N_f+1)L^2/(180t_f^2)$; the leading term is the curvature of a Model D body with half-gap $n\gamma M_k$.

Item 2 at leading order: $\mu_{k,\sigma}=\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}/v^2+O(\gamma^2)$ for every level and branch, with $v=\tau$ for (a) and the full grip and $v=\tau(1+\gamma n)$ for (c); $v$ is the slope at $P\to0$ of the band $\pm v\lvert\sin P\rvert$ of the mean-field motion term alone, attained by no level and independent of $t_f$.

Full grip at order $\gamma^2$ (R1): $\mu_{k,\sigma}-\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}/\tau^2=n\ell_0\gamma^2M_k^2/(t_f\tau^2)+O(\gamma^3)$; branch differences agree through $O(\gamma^2)$, level differences differ by $n\ell_0\gamma^2(M_k^2-M_{k'}^2)/(t_f\tau^2)$, so there is no single $v$ at order $\gamma^2$.

(a), (c) at order $\gamma^2$ and leading order in $\tau$, non-resonant class ((6.4) at $\tau=0$): $D_{k,\sigma}=\mu_{k,\sigma}-\mathrm{Cost}_{k,\sigma}/v^2$ is given explicitly as an average over the one-object excitations; checked against the exact $\tau^2$ coefficient at $N_f=1$.

One speed at order $\gamma^2$ for (a), (c), non-resonant class, leading order in $\tau$: $\tau^2D_{k,\sigma}=n\gamma^2t_f\mathbb F(\sigma M_k/t_f)+O(\gamma^3)$, and one $v$ exists iff the points $(\pm M_k/t_f,\mathbb F(\pm M_k/t_f))$ of all levels lie on one line; for (c) never (positive branch average $\propto M_k^2$); for (a) iff every pair of ratios is a double point of the chord curve, a set with empty interior, so one $v$ fails on an open dense subset; numerical findings (search not shown complete): isolated two-level double points for every $5\le L\le16$, each straddling a one-object resonance, no shared ratio; their orders beyond $\gamma^2$ are out of scope (question note (i)).

Item 3, first order in $g_s$, places not reflection-equivalent with respect to the source ($F\neq0$): $E''_{k,\sigma}(0)\Delta W_{k,\sigma}=\tau^2F\Lambda[1+\sigma\gamma M_k\Xi+O(\gamma^2)]$ with $\Lambda=1$ (full grip), $n\gamma(1\mp\gamma n)$ ((a), (c)) and $\Xi=-(\rho^2+\rho'^2-1)/(3Lt_f)$, $\rho=r-L/2$: universal at leading order, first dependence $\sigma\gamma M_k\Xi$ if $\Xi\neq0$; $\Xi=0$ iff $L$ even and the places are the antipode of the source and a neighbour; for reflection-equivalent places $\Delta W=0$ exactly.

Item 3 at relative order $\gamma^2$: $E''\Delta W/(\tau^2F\Lambda)=1+\sigma\gamma M_k\Xi+\gamma^2M_k^2\Psi_0-\{\gamma^2M_k^2K_L$ (full grip); $\sigma(\tau^2D_{k,\sigma}+C^{\rm ev}_k)/M_k$ ((a), (c))$\}+O(\gamma^3)$; where $\Xi=0$ the first dependence is a level dependence $(\Psi_0-K_L)\gamma^2(M_k^2-M_{k'}^2)$ for the full grip and a branch dependence at relative order $\gamma^2$ for (c) and (a).

Full-grip form of (7.7) for the mean position $\langle\hat x_c\rangle$ in a chart cut at a bond $(c,c+1)$: for a start with real envelope in the dressed band, $a_{k,\sigma}(0)=-E''_{k,\sigma}(0)\sum_j\phi_{j+1}\phi_{j-1}W'_{k,\sigma}(j)+\epsilon_{\rm cut}+O(\tau^2N_f^2g_s^2/d_s^2)+O(\tau^4N_f|g_s|/d_s^3)$, $|\epsilon_{\rm cut}|\le L\tau(\tau+N_f|g|)p_c$ with $p_c$ the probability of the body at $c-1,\dots,c+2$ in the start, under $\tau<d_s/2$, $N_f|g_s|\le d_{k,\sigma}/4$, $d_s\ge d_{k,\sigma}-2N_f|g_s|$; the same argument gives the leading term of (7.7) for (a), (c) for this observable.

Item 4: $v$ is independent of $t_f$; the first level dependence of item 2 stays at order $\gamma^2$, vanishing as $1/t_f$ for large $t_f$ and growing as $1/t_f^2$ in (a), (c) for $t_f\ll M_k$; (a), (c) isolation of $\sigma=+$ at weak mark is (6.4) with sums of up to $N_f$ one-object energies; for the full-grip lower branch the $\tau^2$ coefficient of $E''$ is $O(t_f^{2N_f})$, so $\mu\to\infty$ as $t_f\to0$ with $\tau\to0$ first, and at fixed $\tau$ only while $(t_f/|g|)^{2N_f}\gg(\tau/|g|)^{L-2}$ ($L$ even) or $(t_f/|g|)^{N_f}\gg(\tau/|g|)^{L-3}$ ($L$ odd); (5.6)-(5.10) have no $L\to\infty$ limit at fixed $n,\gamma$; there the branch with $\sigma\gamma<0$ (attractive held block; for (a), (c) the lowest level, $\sigma=+$ if $\gamma<0$) stays isolated with $d\to\sqrt{4t_f^2+\gamma^2M_k^2}-2t_f$ and the branch with $\sigma\gamma>0$ has $d\to0$.

Full-grip lower branch at $t_f=0$, $\tau<|\gamma|M_k/2$: $E''(0)=2(-1)^{L/2}L^2\tau^L/(2^LG^{L-1})$ ($L$ even), $-4L^2\tau^{2L}/(2^{2L}G^{2L-1})$ ($L$ odd), times $1+O(L\tau^2/G^2)$, $G=N_f|\gamma|M_k$, from paths winding the ring; at fixed $\tau$ the exact inertia stays finite as $t_f\to0$.

open_issues: Full grip beyond R1 (strong mark), including the lower branch as L → ∞ at fixed n: (5.2) holds, but items 2 and 3 are not evaluated.
(5.9) and (5.12) are derived at τ → 0 only; the finite-τ bracket of (6.12) is not evaluated.

The double points of (5.12) for (a) are known only numerically, for 5 ≤ L ≤ 16, from a search whose completeness is not established (two grids differ by one point at L = 15); their list, L > 16 and solutions with N ≥ 3 levels are not settled.
The full-grip upper branch for t_f ≲ τL²/(2π²), where (5.4) fails, is not followed.
The prefactors of the order-of-limits conditions at small t_f are not evaluated.
(5.14) is checked at N_f = 1 only; its remainders and the cut bound are bounds, not leading terms (the cut bound exceeds the computed boundary term by about 3·10⁴).
N_f ≥ 2 and the full-grip upper branch beyond 2n|γ|M_k = ε_1 are not checked numerically.
The O(γ) term of (5.10) has a control only in a wider class.
The relation of v = τ to the maximal speed of 03-ilang-space is not quoted here and not used.

consistency_checks.check: γ → 0 and mean field for (a), (c): (5.2)-(5.3) reproduce the mean-field parts of (6.10) and στ²/M_k at γ = 0
Full grip at mean field: leading (5.6) equals the curvature of a Model D body with half-gap nγM_k, whose held cost equals the leading full-grip cost
